Class TelemetrySession

java.lang.Object
tt.uwi.telemetry.model.TelemetrySession
public class TelemetrySession extends Object
Stores a student's telemetry session, including its time range, registered projects, and collected telemetry events.

    • snapshot

      public TelemetrySession snapshot(LocalDateTime captureAt)
      Creates an independent copy of the session at a capture time. The snapshot copies registered projects and events but does not continue changing when the live session receives later events.
      Parameters:
      captureAt - the snapshot end time
      Returns:
      a new session copy with the captured state
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if capture time precedes session start
